title: DeepLens诊断代理：智能工作流设计让小推理模型媲美前沿LLM
summary: 提出DeepLens诊断代理，通过五阶段工作流（结构化临床提取、RAG检索、候选生成、证据三角验证、最终决策）将小模型（JSL Medical Small 7B v2）的诊断准确率从23.99%提升至60.14%，超越Claude Sonnet 4.5和Gemini 3.1 Pro，且成本更低（每例0.0072美元）。工作流约束可弥补参数规模不足，支持可审计的中间结果。
summary_en: The DeepLens Diagnosis Agent uses a five-stage workflow (structured extraction, RAG, candidate generation, evidence triangulation, final decision) to boost a small model's diagnostic accuracy from 23.99% to 60.14%, outperforming Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro at lower cost ($0.0072/case). Workflow constraints compensate for parameter scale and enable auditable intermediate results.
